proposed_fixes.title: Text Extractor activation can dismiss transient UI popups
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Activating capture may change display affinity, focus, or overlay state in a way that causes transient application popups to dismiss before the capture surface is ready.
plan: Trace foreground/focus and overlay activation when Text Extractor starts over a transient Qt tooltip/context menu.
Preserve the target popup long enough for capture when possible without breaking normal dismissal semantics.
Add a regression check using the reporter's Qt6 Anki tooltip sequence.
verification: With the specified Qt6 Anki tooltip open, activate Text Extractor and verify the popup remains visible long enough to select/capture it.

comment.body: Thanks for narrowing the repro to Qt6 Anki 2.1.54 and noting newer Anki versions use different rendering technology. Could you confirm whether the popup still disappears with the current PowerToys release using that Qt6 build, or with another transient popup? Please say whether it disappears before the capture overlay appears. That distinguishes a capture-start focus transition from Anki-specific behavior.
